text:
sarah: @channel quick heads-up — we're publishing the Rust SDK FFI (C-bindings) stability + deprecation plan today. :wave:

jia: Will this affect any Dedicated/Private customers? What's the timeline?

sarah: Short version: mark the FFI as 'maintenance' (no new features) today, deprecate in 90 days, remove in 365 days. Native Rust API remains fully supported. We'll offer an extended opt-in window for Dedicated/Private—PMs to coordinate outreach.

matt: From eng: CI will build the native crate + c-ffi on every PR for the next 90 days, add ABI checks, and expose a cargo feature `c-ffi` so teams can opt-in. We'll also publish a nightly ABI checker binary.

samir: For folks migrating, recommend switching to the native crate usage: 
```
// recommended migration: prefer native crate
let client = redwood::Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_API_KEY").unwrap());
```
For the C bindings, headers will remain in the repo but flagged as deprecated in docs and audits.

allen: Docs action items (I'll own): migration guide draft, compatibility matrix, update quickstarts, add FAQ + deprecation notice banner on top-level Rust page. I'll have a first draft by EOD Monday.

docs-bot: Published: docs PR #4201 by allen — "rust: FFI deprecation and migration guide (WIP)" (automated).

jia: We also need a comms plan: blog post + Dedicated customer email + support playbook. Can we get a short TL;DR for sales/support?

sarah: Yes — blog + email + support script. @matt @allen please prepare a 3-bullet TL;DR and an FAQ for support. I'll loop in legal for final wording on deprecation.

allen: I'll add a timeline table and a minimal ABI-stability checklist under the migration doc. Example check: run `./tools/abi-checker --baseline v1.2.0 --target HEAD`.

matt: Ops note: we'll pin older C-based runtime containers for Dedicated customers for 12 months and emit runtime warnings when apps load the deprecated FFI.

sarah: OK — thanks everyone. If you have blockers or large customers impacted, ping me directly. Will post the RFC and final PR link once merged. :thumbsup:
